title: Inter Miami faces NYC FC in a 2026 clash
seoTitle: Inter Miami vs NYC FC 2026: Match Preview & Transit
subtitle: The upcoming Inter Miami match brings transportation updates and stadium betting news
excerpt: Inter Miami CF and New York City FC face off on the night of October 14 at Nu Stadium. The duel features transit promotions, head-to-head history, and lineups.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Inter Miami CF, World Soccer Talk
contentHtml:
The matchup between Inter Miami CF and New York City FC is trending because the game brings transit promotions, head-to-head history, and projected lineups for the clash on October 14 at Nu Stadium.

stadium transportation promotions

Inter Miami CF is offering a $10 round-trip Tri-Rail ticket to the Miami Intermodal Center (MIC) in 2026. The ticket includes a $10 food and beverage credit, valid at Guest Services near Section 101 of the stadium. The offer is only valid via the team's official link.

parking and bag conditions

Matchday parking passes are only available in the Yellow Lot; the Audi Black Lot and Red Lot are sold out. Stadium entry restricts the size and type of bags, recommending that fans avoid bringing purses.

recent team standings

Inter Miami CF has 13 wins, 5 losses, and 10 draws, totaling 49 points and sitting in second place in the Eastern Conference. The team leads the season in goals with 68, and has Lionel Messi as their top scorer with 23 goals. NYCFC, meanwhile, has 8 wins, 11 losses, and 9 draws, totaling 33 points and occupying tenth position in the same conference.

historical head-to-head

So far, Inter Miami has won four, drawn four, and lost seven of 16 matches against NYCFC. The team remains undefeated in their last seven matches against the New York club, with 3 wins and 4 draws. Their last encounter, in March, ended in a 3-2 Inter Miami victory at Yankee Stadium.

projected lineups for the game

Inter Miami is expected to start in a 4-3-3 formation, led by German Berterame, Luis Suárez, and Lionel Messi. The defense will feature Dayne St. Clair, Sergio Reguilón, Micael, and Gonzalo Luján. The midfield will be formed by Casemiro, Matías Galarza, Rodrigo De Paul, and David Ayala.

NYCFC Lineup

NYCFC is expected to employ a 4-2-3-1, with Aiden O’Neill and Andres Perea as defensive anchors, and the front line led by Alonso Martínez. The backline will be composed of James Sands, Thiago Martins, Nico Cavallo, and Tayvon Gray, with Matt Freese in goal.

With information from Inter Miami CF, World Soccer Talk.
